turns.text: Have you got colour in your cheeks?
turns.zh: 你脸上有没有泛起红晕？

turns.text: Do you ever get the fear that you can't shift the type
turns.zh: 你有没有过那种恐惧，怕自己摆脱不了那种

turns.text: That sticks around like summat in your teeth?
turns.zh: 像牙缝里塞了东西一样甩不掉的类型？

turns.text: Are there some aces up your sleeve?
turns.zh: 你是不是藏着什么王牌？

turns.text: Have you no idea that you're in deep?
turns.zh: 你难道不知道你已经陷得很深了吗？

turns.text: I dreamt about you nearly every night this week
turns.zh: 这周我几乎每晚都梦见你

turns.text: How many secrets can you keep?
turns.zh: 你能守住多少秘密？

turns.text: 'Cause there's this tune I found
turns.zh: 因为我找到了这段旋律

turns.text: That makes me think of you somehow
turns.zh: 不知怎么的它让我想起你

turns.text: And I play it on repeat
turns.zh: 我把它单曲循环

turns.text: Until I fall asleep
turns.zh: 直到我睡着

turns.text: Spilling drinks on my settee
turns.zh: 把酒洒在我的沙发上

turns.text: (Do I wanna know?)
turns.zh: （我到底想不想知道？）

turns.text: If this feeling flows both ways?
turns.zh: 这份感觉是不是双向的？

turns.text: (Sad to see you go)
turns.zh: （看你走真难过）

turns.text: Was sorta hoping that you'd stay
turns.zh: 我其实有点希望你会留下

turns.text: (Baby, we both know)
turns.zh: （宝贝，我们都清楚）

turns.text: That the nights were mainly made
turns.zh: 夜晚主要就是用来

turns.text: For saying things that you can't say tomorrow day
turns.zh: 说那些你白天说不出口的话

turns.text: Crawling back to you
turns.zh: 爬回你身边

turns.text: Ever thought of calling when you've had a few?
turns.zh: 有没有想过喝了几杯之后打电话？

turns.text: 'Cause I always do
turns.zh: 因为我总是这样

turns.text: Maybe I'm too
turns.zh: 也许我太

turns.text: Busy being yours to fall for somebody new
turns.zh: 忙着属于你，没法爱上别人

turns.text: Now I've thought it through
turns.zh: 现在我想清楚了

turns.text: Crawling back to you
turns.zh: 爬回你身边

turns.text: So have you got the guts?
turns.zh: 所以你有那个胆量吗？

turns.text: Been wondering if your heart's still open
turns.zh: 一直在想你的心是不是还敞开着

turns.text: And if so, I wanna know what time it shuts
turns.zh: 如果是的话，我想知道它几点关门

turns.text: Simmer down and pucker up
turns.zh: 冷静下来，撅起嘴

turns.text: I'm sorry to interrupt, it's just I'm constantly on the cusp
turns.zh: 抱歉打断你，只是我总在

turns.text: Of trying to kiss you
turns.zh: 快要吻你的边缘

turns.text: I don't know if you feel the same as I do
turns.zh: 我不知道你是不是和我有同样的感觉

turns.text: But we could be together if you wanted to
turns.zh: 但如果你愿意，我们可以在一起

turns.zh: （我到底想不想知道？）
